notes.run-driver: The driver: it does what the flow asks for, and answers with a command.
notes.run-flow: Decides how `clp run` proceeds, from the specs to verified code: what to do next, where an answer leads, and how the run ends. Each round reads Layer 1, offers the splits, interprets, and asks the open questions; a round that changed Layer 1 is followed by another, and a round with nothing left to change accepts, applies and ends.
notes.run-flow.does.accepted: If not everything was accepted, the run finishes with not-accepted. Otherwise the code is brought into agreement.
notes.run-flow.does.applied: The run finishes: pass with passed, fail with not-verified, agent-failed with apply-agent, spec-error with spec.
notes.run-flow.does.candidate: A candidate: an agent is asked how to split it.
notes.run-flow.does.interpreted: If a file was interpreted, the next is. When everything is up to date, the questions are read and the next question is asked for. If interpreting failed, the run finishes with interpret-failed; if the agent failed, with interpret-agent.
notes.run-flow.does.layer1Checked: If Layer 1 does not read, the run finishes with layer1. Otherwise the next candidate is asked for.
notes.run-flow.does.noMoreCandidates: If a split was accepted in this round, Layer 1 changed: the next round starts (as in Start). Otherwise interpreting starts, and the first file is interpreted.
notes.run-flow.does.noMoreQuestions: If a question was supplemented, the supplements are placed. Otherwise the questions are done, and the interpretations are accepted.
notes.run-flow.does.proposed: With no proposal, the next candidate is asked for. With a proposal, the person is asked. If the agent failed, the run finishes with split-agent.
notes.run-flow.does.question: A question: the person is asked.
notes.run-flow.does.questionAnswered: On stop, the run finishes with person. On accept, the reading is marked as reviewed; on supplement, that a question was supplemented is remembered for this round. Either way the next question is asked for.
notes.run-flow.does.splitAnswered: On stop, the run finishes with person. On accept, the split is written and remembered for this round; on decline, the refusal is recorded. Either way the next candidate is asked for.
notes.run-flow.does.start: A run starts with the most rounds it may take, and whether supplements are written without asking. The first round starts: if a round would go past the limit, the run finishes with rounds; otherwise its supplement and split marks are cleared and Layer 1 is checked.
notes.run-flow.does.supplementsConfirmed: If the person refuses, the run finishes with not-written. Otherwise the supplements are written, the questions are done, and the next round starts (as in Start).
notes.run-flow.does.supplementsPlaced: If some supplement has no place, the run finishes with unplaced. If supplements are written unasked, they are written, the questions are done, and the next round starts (as in Start). Otherwise the person is asked to confirm.
notes.run-flow.examples.aSplitInTheLastRound: A split accepted in the last round: the run ends for lack of rounds.
notes.run-flow.examples.aSupplementWithNoPlace: A supplement with no sentence to go to ends the run.
notes.run-flow.examples.theLastRoundIsConfirme: Confirmed in the last round: the run ends for lack of rounds.
notes.run-flow.examples.theLastRoundWritesUnas: Written unasked in the last round: the run ends for lack of rounds.
notes.run-flow.examples.thePersonRefusesTheCha: The person refuses the change to Layer 1.
notes.run-flow.examples.thePersonStopsAtAQuest: The person stops at a question.
notes.run-flow.examples.thePersonStopsAtASplit: The person stops at a proposed split.
